# Pure complete-file claim packet codec (original functional contract)

Implement only `packages/tianwen-evolution/src/conversation-file-claim-packet.ts`.
Export `packConversationFileClaimPacket(original: unknown, claimEvidence: unknown)` and `unpackConversationFileClaimPacket(packet: unknown)` and appropriate readonly interfaces. Only Node22 standard library and local `learning-intake.js` sha256/canonicalJson and `conversation-files.js` existing parseConversationFileMaterial/Entries may be imported. No I/O or execution.

Inputs are JSON data, with complete original-result (`source`) or method-study (`task`) review data. Exactly one of source/task is present, its files are the existing v1 material with outputKind files; fileResult has exactly answer/files/outputDigest, outputDigest=sha256({answer,files}), final paths exactly match initial paths in original order and every declared output is non-null. Preserve all other original JSON fields (request, criteria, quality, conversation, facts, actions, feedback, trial proof, etc.), do not reinterpret them. Existing file parser is authoritative for path/content/count/byte/output rules.

Evidence is exactly {schemaVersion:'tianwen.claim-evidence.v2',items,evidenceDigest}, evidenceDigest=sha256(items). Items are closed with required id/role/origin/text and optional toolStatus/filePath/fileStage; roles user/assistant/tool/answer, origins context/request/tool/answer, id matches its origin-N with N positive, all IDs unique. toolStatus only success/error; filePath and fileStage are present together, fileStage initial/final, initial role/origin tool and final role/origin answer. All JSON arrays are dense with no custom/symbol keys; objects have ordinary or null prototypes, own enumerable data properties only, no symbol/non-enumerable/accessor keys. Reject cycles, functions, undefined, non-finite numbers, malformed UTF16/lone surrogates. Each serialized original/evidence/packet and reconstructed original must be <=512KiB UTF8. Do not mutate any input. Each return is a fresh independent data graph, including nested evidence objects and metadata.

Pack returns exactly {schemaVersion:'tianwen.file-claim-review-packet.v1',original:<skeleton>,claimEvidence:<full fresh evidence>,originalDigest:sha256(original)}. Only known file content slots may be replaced with exactly {evidenceIds:[...]}:

- Each non-null initial file content MUST become a reference to ALL evidence file items of the same exact path, initial stage, role/origin tool, in original evidence order. Concatenation of their text must equal the exact original content. There must be at least one item even for an empty file. Keep null as null.
- Each non-null declared final output content MUST reference ALL same-path final answer items in original order, with concatenation equal exact original content. Do not use initial source items for a generated answer, even for identical bytes. Keep any initially present output's initial content bound to initial items separately.
- Final input-only content becomes the same initial-path reference ONLY when its exact string equals that file's initial content. If it differs or initial content was null, preserve its full literal string. Null remains null. Do not erase or relabel read-only drift.
- References elsewhere in original data are ordinary preserved JSON, not interpreted. Literal `{evidenceIds:...}` in a file's text is still text and must round trip. Never recursively substitute arbitrary user data fields.

Unpack accepts ONLY the closed packet v1 with valid lowercase sha256:<64 hex> originalDigest. It reconstructs ONLY those known content slots from their permitted complete exact ID group; reject missing/extra/duplicate/reversed IDs, extra ref keys, unknown IDs, cross-file/cross-stage/role references, null output or invalid files. It must reject noncanonical skeletons (e.g. a literal where pack requires a reference, or a reference where final input-only drift should remain literal). Verify both evidenceDigest and originalDigest and that packing reconstructed original/evidence yields the same canonical packet. Return exactly {original:<complete fresh original>,claimEvidence:<complete fresh evidence>}.

This codec does not authenticate evidence provenance, ensure full projection equivalence to original material, judge source authority, grant tool permissions, or assign task success/learning. Runtime's existing host verifier must reproject and bind expected task/output/model/native proof after decoding.

Original acceptance: all frozen entry.mjs assertions pass, stdout exactly JSON {"passed":true}, exit0, stderr empty. Input arguments must remain unchanged. Do not change this contract, entry, references, current SDK, tests or learning criteria. Do not execute anything; host will evaluate the saved output once. Final reply should state delivery without claiming tests were run by you.
